name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of Transmutation) — 1 Basic — Crystallize the Liquid Form

system.description: By spending a Mental Trait, the thaumaturge transforms up to one Blood Trait's worth of liquid into solid form without altering its temperature or volatility; liquid within a living body cannot be affected. The transformed material reverts to liquid at the end of the scene. This path retests with the Occult Ability and functions upon any object within the thaumaturge's direct line of sight, though blood within a living body cannot be affected.
